A1.2 • PESSOAS PRÓXIMAS • FINAL LANDING

My People Map

Review the route. Connect the details. Present the people who matter.

Understand two integrated listenings.
Read profiles and find details.
Describe two or three people.
Send the final production to the teacher.
1

Reconnect the route

Put the information in a useful order.

4-5 min

A. Put the route in a useful order. Write 1-6.

Imagine you are introducing one person. Number the six information types from 1 (say this first) to 6 (say this last). Use each number once.

Safe choice: Use a real or fictional person. Share only information you are comfortable sharing.
2

Listen • A family portrait

Track 10A • Listen twice.

7-8 min
First listening: follow the family lines. Second listening: complete the names and details.

A. Write the names.

B. Listen for details.

C. Rebuild the portrait.

Use the family map and write four complete sentences.

3

Read and connect

Find the relationship, facts and qualities.

6-7 min

A • Rosa

Rosa is Mia's grandmother. She is 68 and she is from Salvador, Brazil. She is short. She has short curly gray hair and brown eyes. She is patient and funny. She lives in São Paulo with Mia's aunt.

B • Noah

Noah is Liam's cousin. He is 19 and he is from Toronto, Canada. He is tall. He has short black hair and glasses. He is outgoing and helpful. He lives in Montreal with his parents.

C • Lila

Lila is Ava's best friend. She is 27 and she is from Cape Town, South Africa. She is of medium height. She has long curly black hair. She is creative and calm. She lives near Ava.

Write Rosa, Noah or Lila.

4

Language dock

is • are • has • have • lives • pronouns

5-6 min
is / are
age, origin and personality
has / have
physical features and family
lives / live
where someone lives
's / possessives
relationships and possession

Complete with one word.

American English target: She has curly hair. They have brown eyes.
5

Listening challenge • Three family photos

Play the speakers together or one at a time.

7-8 min
Speaker 1
Speaker 2
Speaker 3

A. Match each summary to Speaker 1, 2 or 3.

B. Complete the names.

6

Build My People Map

Two people required • third optional.

6-7 min

If yes, I will omit: Choose only the type of information.

Do not write the private information itself.

7

Final writing

Describe two people. A third person is optional.

8-10 min
Useful order: Two important people in my life are… • First,… • Another important person is… • They are important to me because…

Final check

8

Oral challenge

Present your map for 90-120 seconds.

8-10 min
00:00
